# pycc

> pycc is a pre-alpha strict ahead-of-time compiler for typed, standard Python 3.14 that produces native binaries through Rust and LLVM. AI agents create it, and a human manages it.

pycc compiles an implemented subset of Python 3.14, not the whole language,
and is not ready for production. Every type annotation is enforced at compile
time; type errors are compile errors. The status page and the roadmap below
are the current account of what works; this file deliberately repeats no
status claims so it cannot drift from them.

AI agents write the specifications, code, tests, documentation and reviews; a
human sets goals and constraints. pycc is not an AI or machine-learning
compiler: "AI-native" describes how it is built.

## Project

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rotnov/pycc/main/README.md): Positioning, quick start, build instructions and quality policy.
- [Current status](https://rotnov.github.io/pycc/status/): Per-area implementation status, generated from the roadmap at deploy time.
- [Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rotnov/pycc/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): Milestones, acceptance criteria, and the evidence and remaining gap for each area.

## Specifications

- [Specification index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rotnov/pycc/main/docs/SPEC.md): Map of the documents that define project behavior.
- [Compiler architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rotnov/pycc/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Pipeline, crate boundaries and platform model.
- [Python standards matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rotnov/pycc/main/docs/PYTHON_STANDARDS.md): Targeted Python 3.14 language standards and their implementation status.
- [CLI specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rotnov/pycc/main/docs/CLI_SPEC.md): Commands, flags and diagnostic output.
- [Diagnostics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rotnov/pycc/main/docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md): Diagnostic codes and their meaning.
